none: PAS NLM-9FB4B6: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of House of Valentinian (364-378), Gloria Romanorum issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding standard and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLO]RIA RO[MANORVM]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin. Diameter: 16.5mm, Weight: 1.38gms, die axis: 12
